description: AGSC-09-10 with AGSC-09-11: under --json the findings of ci are ordered by (file, line, col, code), compared code-point-wise, in the envelope and on stderr alike, and every finding carries code, col, file, line, message and severity — including the findings that have no position of their own. The case is the minimal fixture with three files added, run with no SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in a directory that is not a git checkout. Derivation from the rule text: with no SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and no git history the build instant is 0 with the warning AGSC-E606 (AGSC-04-09), a finding about no file, so its file is the empty string and it sorts before every path; the authored security.txt carries an Expires after that instant, so it raises nothing. content/concepts/README.md is a folder note, skipped with the warning AGSC-E506 (AGSC-01-05), a finding about a whole file, so it carries line 1 and col 1. content/concepts/beacon.md is a pattern concept with no description and no Related Patterns section, two warnings of AGSC-02-21 (AGSC-E408, AGSC-E406), and a tag outside tags.allowed, the error AGSC-E203 of AGSC-01-21, so ci fails with exit 1 (AGSC-09-08). Code-point order puts README.md (R is U+0052) before beacon.md (b is U+0062), the order a case-insensitive or locale sort reverses. findings_in_order lists findings that must appear in that relative order; findings lists findings that must appear, in any order; ordered_by names the sort key every adjacent pair must respect; stderr_lines_match_findings says that the finding objects on stderr are the envelope's, one per line, in the same order.
